report_name: ShinyHunters Bypasses WAFs in Renewed Oracle PeopleSoft Attacks

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: Resumed mass exploitation of CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft, using a URL-encoding trick to bypass WAFs. The campaign targets healthcare, technology, and government sectors, deploying the SIDEEYE backdoor and MeshCentral for persistence.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor exploited CVE-2026-35273, a remote code execution vulnerability in internet-facing Oracle PeopleSoft servers, to gain initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
attack_patterns.description: Used URL encoding (e.g., replacing 'P' with '%50') to obfuscate the malicious request path `/PSEMHUB/` and bypass pattern-matching Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules.

attack_patterns.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
attack_patterns.description: Deployed web shells on compromised PeopleSoft servers for initial persistence after successful exploitation.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Access Software
attack_patterns.description: Installed the legitimate remote management tool MeshCentral to maintain persistent access and for command and control.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: Transferred and deployed the SIDEEYE backdoor and MeshCentral remote access tool onto compromised servers.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The deployed SIDEEYE backdoor has the capability to perform credential theft from the compromised system.

attack_patterns.name: Proxy
attack_patterns.description: The SIDEEYE backdoor is capable of acting as a network proxy on the compromised server.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Used PowerShell with encoded commands for execution, as suggested by hunting hints for `powershell.exe -enc`.

malware.name: SIDEEYE
malware.description: A new multi-stage backdoor deployed on compromised Windows PeopleSoft servers by ShinyHunters. It provides capabilities for credential theft, file/process management, and acting as a network proxy.

tools.name: MeshCentral
tools.description: Legitimate remote management tool installed by ShinyHunters for secondary access, persistence, and command and control on compromised PeopleSoft servers.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-35273
vulnerabilities.description: A critical unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Oracle PeopleSoft, exploited by ShinyHunters using a URL-encoding WAF bypass technique.

infrastructure.name: MeshCentral C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Command and control infrastructure used by the legitimate remote management tool MeshCentral, which was abused by ShinyHunters for persistence and C2.

indicators.name: ShinyHunters PeopleSoft WAF Bypass Pattern
indicators.pattern:
title: ShinyHunters PeopleSoft WAF Bypass Pattern
id: 4d9f1c8a-6b3e-4f8d-9a2c-1b7e5a0d9f6e
status: experimental
description: Detects URL-encoded patterns used to bypass WAF rules targeting the Oracle PeopleSoft /PSEMHUB/ endpoint, as seen in ShinyHunters campaigns.
references:
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/shinyhunters-renewed-mass-exploitation-campaign-targeting-oracle-peoplesoft
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1027
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/%50SEMHUB/'
      - '/P%53EMHUB/'
      - '/PSE%4dHUB/'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects URL-encoded requests to the /PSEMHUB/ endpoint, a technique used by ShinyHunters to bypass WAF rules.

id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-8b1a-0f9e8d7c6b5b

description: Detects DNS queries for meshcentral.com from servers not expected to use this tool, such as Oracle PeopleSoft servers.
references:
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/shinyhunters-renewed-mass-exploitation-campaign-targeting-oracle-peoplesoft
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:

level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows

indicators.name: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
id: f8e7d6c5-4b3a-4e2d-8c1b-0a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of PowerShell with the '-enc' flag, which is often used by attackers to obfuscate malicious scripts.
references:
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/shinyhunters-renewed-mass-exploitation-campaign-targeting-oracle-peoplesoft
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -enc '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of `powershell.exe -enc`, a common technique for obfuscating malicious commands.
